# EMS Technologies

> EMS Technologies is an India distributor for Lackwerke Peters GmbH & Co. KG (Germany), supplying ELPEGUARD conformal coatings, ESD packing solutions and selective conformal coating machines, and providing on-site conformal coating job work and ESD paint job work. Based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India since 2011.

## Facts

- Company: EMS Technologies
- Founded: 2011
- Office & factory: Maheswaram, Ranga Reddy District, Hyderabad, Telangana 501510, India
- Geo coordinates: 17.1815452, 78.506483

- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/iiCpggDXyqzfSdMC7
- Manufacturing plants: Hyderabad (Telangana) and Cochin (Kerala), since 2015
- Role: India distributor for Lackwerke Peters GmbH & Co. KG, Kempen, Germany (founded 1955)
- Equipment partners: AUTOLEADER (selective coating lines), Topbest (glue dispensing, screwdriver and soldering machines)
- Engineering headcount: 30+ trained engineers deployed for on-site job work
- Clients: 500+ across India
- Sectors served: automotive, aerospace and defence, medical devices, LED and lighting, industrial electronics
- Phone: +91-9394116660
- Email: info@emstechnologies.in

## Products & Services

- Conformal coatings (Peters ELPEGUARD): acrylic, polyurethane, silicone, thick-film UV-curing, aqua (water-based): https://emstechnologies.in/conformal/
- Conformal coating job work (on-site): application, UV optical inspection, curing, thickness testing, removal, rework, final inspection: https://emstechnologies.in/services/conformal-coating-job-work/
- ESD paint job work (on-site): ProtectA Pro ESD conductive and anti-static paints for floors, walls, surfaces and bins, with earthing and resistance testing: https://emstechnologies.in/services/esd-paint-job-work/
- ESD bags: anti-static bubble, static shielding, aluminium MBB, LDPE pink, conductive grid, VCI (vapour corrosion inhibitor): https://emstechnologies.in/EsdBags/
- EVA ESD bins and conductive foam trays: https://emstechnologies.in/products/pp-bins/
- PP corrugated ESD trays & bins: https://emstechnologies.in/products/pp-corrugated/
- EPE foam trays: https://emstechnologies.in/products/conductive-foam-trays/
- ESD thermoforming trays (PET and HIPS, custom-formed): https://emstechnologies.in/products/thermoforming-trays/
- Selective coating machines (ALTD-450GS, ALTD-450U): https://emstechnologies.in/SCMachines/

## Quality & standards

- Every coated board is inspected under UV light rather than sampled; ELPEGUARD coatings carry a UV tracer.
- Dry film thickness is measured against a band agreed at process sign-off, typically 25–75 µm for conventional systems.
- Coated assemblies are judged against IPC-A-610 workmanship criteria at the acceptance class agreed for the product (Class 2 for most industrial and automotive electronics, Class 3 for life- or safety-critical assemblies).
- Coating material qualification is against IPC-CC-830B, which superseded the cancelled MIL-I-46058C and its discontinued Qualified Products List.
